title: 840. Split Array into Fibonacci Sequence

examples.explanation: Each value sums the prior two.

hints: Try every split for the first two numbers (at most 10 digits each given the 32-bit cap), then extend deterministically.
Reject any piece with a leading zero unless it is exactly '0', and stop when a value exceeds 2147483647.
Once the first pair is fixed, the rest of the sequence is forced: keep matching the expected sum as a prefix.
